resources.string: Detects the foreground app so pen haptics are only enabled for apps on your whitelist. Does not read screen content.
When on, haptics are enabled only while a whitelisted app is in the foreground, and turned off everywhere else (home screen, scrolling, …).
Pick the apps that should get pen haptics. Input methods are listed too — tick your keyboard if you want haptics in its handwriting field.
Foreground detection is off — auto mode will not work
